description: A Java class 'LogView' extending TextView that implements LogNode interface, used for displaying log data in an Android application. It formats log messages and appends them to the view, supporting chaining of log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for outputting log data received through the LogNode interface, with support for log message formatting and chaining.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for LogView with different parameter sets.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, runs UI update on the main thread, and forwards to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
